scope: Exact browser helper source and pure evidence-classifier recipe admission; conditional, not whole runtime authorization or observed browser acceptance

acceptance.originalResponseBytes: Exact captured original bridge decoded bytes must equal actual browser stream byte length and SHA256, with unique request/capture identity.
acceptance.requiredProfileAction: Fresh sealed-artifact compiled export, Playwright/bridge/CDP Next-Action equality, exact root Flight result and uniquely timestamp/field/email-bound DOM consumer required.
acceptance.denial: All declared actor ID/email/organization canaries absent from original bytes and DOM; no missing/empty classification; native snapshots unchanged.
acceptance.cancellation: Every loadingFailed and Playwright error retained. A canceled required profile response additionally needs exact browser bytes and unique resolved consumer plus separately fresh user refresh; canceled prefetch additionally needs exact speculative provenance and same-context real navigation with fresh required read. This is an explicit successor consumer contract and does not turn old strict completion failures into passes.
acceptance.snapshot: snapshotHash is source-bound hidden DTO revision; it is not asserted to be a rendered DOM field.

conditionsBeforeExecution: Separately reviewed exact runtime wrapper and bridge, isolated environment guard, real fixtures and actual build/artifact outcome.
Derive action binding freshly from accepted sealed artifact; do not reuse old artifact action identifiers.
Recheck all helper hashes and source binding before invocation.
Retain every selected response and terminal event; fail closed on unsupported stream capture, incomplete bytes, ambiguity, duplicate consumption signatures, cache substitution or unmatched requests.
limitations: No product/UI edits in this lane.
No actual browser, native database or app outcome has been observed by this receipt.
Existing old strict browser outcomes remain immutable.
Does not certify full localization/accessibility/mobile/BFCache or P04-R07 workflows.
